brief:
Israeli military vehicles stormed Hebron in the occupied West Bank as the army began a days-long lockdown of the city, Middle East Eye reported. Around 20 vehicles entered Hebron as part of the operation.

The lockdown restricts movement in and out of the Palestinian city, a frequent flashpoint in the West Bank where Israeli settlers and Palestinians live in close proximity.
dek: Military vehicles storm West Bank’s Hebron as Israeli army starts days-long lockdown Around 20 Israeli military vehicles stormed the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera reported, citing its correspondents on the ground.
title: Israeli army locks down Hebron with military vehicles
